title: Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio Rocks Your Christmas
summary: Listen on the SiriusXM app now through December 26.
body_markdown:
Get ready to rock with Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio! Celebrate the holidays with the band’s signature blend of powerful electric guitars, orchestral arrangements, and soaring vocals, where rock meets classical music and Christmas classics take on an epic new sound.


[Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio Available through December 27 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHolidayChannels2026)


## Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio


### How to Listen


**Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio** is available exclusively on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHolidayChannels2026) from **November 2 through December 27, 2026** .


### What You’ll Hear


Hear Trans-Siberian Orchestra’s iconic Christmas discography, exclusive concert recordings, and much more. The channel celebrates the band’s unique fusion of rock and classical music, bringing together holiday favorites, electrifying instrumentals, and powerful storytelling.


---


SiriusXM’s 2026 holiday lineup features **25 festive music channels** , including favorites from Jimmy Fallon, Hallmark, and Mannheim Steamroller. From traditional Christmas carols and country favorites to holiday rock, jazz, Hanukkah music, and seasonal soul, there’s something for everyone.


[Explore all 25 SiriusXM holiday music channels for 2026, including channel numbers, dates, and where to listen.](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/siriusxm-holiday-channels-2026)
